schema_changes.change: Added schema_version 1 registry records with pinned source identity, license, allowed paths, capability areas, destination, owner, review date, and update policy.
Added versioned manual handoff envelope fields, evidence references, lifecycle status, and parent_task-or-coverage_cell routing requirement.
Added optional bug-bounty recon manifest fields for ownership anchors, live status, ranked surfaces, and redacted secret references.

configuration_dependency_changes.note: The read-only upstream checker uses this registry by default; no existing engagement runtime or queue requires it.

public_export_impact.check: Run export dry-run and public leak/allowlist checks; private provenance and hunting playbooks remain excluded.

bug_bounty_impact.check: Optional recon-manifest validation and reviewed playbook guidance add bug-bounty support without changing scope, queue, findings, or evidence authority.

ctf_impact.check: Synthetic CTF structure remains separate and untouched; no CTF schema or template path changed.

expected_behavior.old: A compatible older engagement branch may be dry-run and backpatched with framework paths only; engagement data remains manual.
expected_behavior.current: A branch already matching main is an idempotent no-op after the compatibility report.
expected_behavior.beta: A beta-version branch is not promoted by this helper; operator reviews the report and release gates first.

risks.risk: A dirty worktree or an unclassified merge conflict could overwrite engagement state.
risks.mitigation: The helper stops before switching dirty worktrees and leaves engagement or unclassified conflicts for manual resolution.
